\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{manyfoot}
\usepackage{url}
% BUG-30: \DeclareNewFootnote{A}[arabic] defines \footnoteA.
% The pipeline strips this declaration from the preamble (it is not a
% \newcommand, \def, or \newtheorem and is not in build_minimal_preamble's
% preserved-pattern list). As a result, \footnoteA is undefined in the output.
\DeclareNewFootnote{A}[arabic]
\begin{document}
Main text.\footnoteA{This is a manyfoot footnote.}
More text.\footnoteA{\url{https://example.com}}
\end{document}
